links.comparator_used: Base OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1 without enhancement (RAG, ICL and majority voting were tested only as a combined package)
links.outcome: Accuracy on prosthodontic multiple-choice questions (Chinese C-MCQs and English E-MCQs)
links.effect: C-MCQs: significant accuracy improvement for both enhanced models (P < .001). E-MCQs: higher accuracy but not statistically significant (P = .145). Knowledge-based errors in C-MCQs were significantly reduced (P < .008) but only non-significantly reduced in E-MCQs (P = .604).
links.quote: Enhanced versions of both DeepSeek-R1 and OpenAI o1 achieved significant accuracy improvement compared with their base versions in Chinese-language multiple-choice questions (C-MCQs) (P < .001).
